remarks.zh: 计算柜子的板材尺寸。[宽度]、[高度]和[深度]为总的尺寸，[板厚度]是顶部、底部和侧板的材料厚度，[背板厚度]是背景板的材料厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah ukuran keseluruhan, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah dan sisi, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah ukuran total, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah, dan sisi, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดแผ่นไม้สำหรับตู้ [Width], [Height], [Depth] เป็นขนาดรวม [BoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นยอด แผ่นล่างและแผ่นข้าง [BackBoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính toán kích thước bảng cho tủ. [Width], [Height],[Depth] là kích thước tổng thể, [BoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng trên, dưới và bảng bên, [BackBoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng sau. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng board para sa kabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] ay kabuuang Pagsukat, [BoardThick] ay ang kapal ng materyal ng Top, Bottom at Side Board, [BackBoardThick] ay ang kapal ng materyal para sa Background Board. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.my: ကက်ဘိနက်တွက်ရန်အတွက်ဘုတ်အုတ်စုစုပေါင်း၏အတိုင်းအတာကိုတွက်ချက်သည်။ [Width]၊ [Height]၊ [Depth] သည်စုစုပေါင်းတိုင်းတာမှုဖြစ်ပြီး၊ [BoardThick] သည်ထိပ်ပိုင်း၊ အောက်ပိုင်းနှင့် ဘေးဘုတ်ဖွဲ့စည်းပစ္စည်းအထူကိုဆိုလိုသည်၊ [BackBoardThick] သည်နောက်ဘက်ဘုတ်ဖွဲ့စည်းပစ္စည်းအထူဖြစ်သည်။(AI translated, please check)
remarks.km: គណនាអក្សរដើម្បីធ្វើឱ្យមានអតិភាពត្រូវបានគេបង្រៀនសម្រាប់ផ្សារ ខ្នាតសរុប[Width] [Height][Depth] គឺការវាស់ទំហំសរុប។ [BoardThick] គឺជាភាពក្រិត [BackBoardThick] គឺជាភាពក្រាស់នៃសម្ភារៈផ្ទះបាយ។ (AI translated, please check)
